reta.basesHint: Bases are read-only here. Record each one from its TGSS resolution with the {command} command; see {doc}.
reta.boundarySensitive: Your income is close to a tramo limit: a few more rows can move it to the next tramo.
reta.disclaimer: Decision support, not a TGSS resolution. These estimates are never added to or netted against the AEAT tax payments above.
reta.reasons.base_above_table_maximum: A recorded base exceeds the maximum of the imported table. Check the table and the base.
reta.reasons.base_below_table_minimum: A recorded base is below the table minimum (a special base); its regularisation is not modelled.
reta.reasons.base_missing: Some alta days have no recorded base. Record the base from your TGSS resolution.
reta.reasons.ledger_blocked: A ledger error blocks the income calculation; it also blocks the tax calculations.
reta.reasons.period_missing: A quarter in alta has no ledger period yet. Record its rows.
reta.reasons.profile_unavailable: The check needs exactly one taxpayer profile.
reta.reasons.table_unavailable: The RETA table of this year is not imported yet.
reta.reasons.tarifa_plana_extension_unve: A tarifa plana runs past month 12. Record the extension resolution from month 13, or the base that followed.
reta.reasons.unposted_rows_in_window: Some rows in the checked months are still in review or not posted. Post or reject them.
reta.reasons.window_empty: No regularisable day yet: no month of the year has ended, there is no alta, or only tarifa plana days.
reta.reasons.worker_kind_changed: The worker kind changed during the year; the check does not split the year.
reta.reasons.worker_kind_floor_unverifie: Societarios and familiares colaboradores have a minimum base the check does not model.
reta.regime: {regime, select, base {Elected base} tarifa_plana {Tarifa plana} other {Other regime}}
reta.statusDetail.above_bracket: Your bases so far total more than the tramo maximum. TGSS would refund the difference.
reta.statusDetail.below_bracket: Your bases so far total less than the tramo minimum. TGSS would ask for an additional payment.
reta.statusDetail.ok: Your bases so far are between the tramo minimum and maximum. Nothing would be regularised.
reta.statusDetail.unknown: The check has no result: an input is missing or cannot be verified.
reta.title: RETA bracket check {year}
reta.tramoValue: {table, select, reduced {Reduced table} general {General table} other {Table}}, tramo {tramo}
